title: swell — criterion

sentences.sentence: Her ankle was already starting to swell.
sentences.translation: 她的脚踝已经开始肿起来了。

sentences.sentence: The window frame was swollen shut.
sentences.translation: 窗框膨胀变形，关得死死的。

sentences.sentence: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
sentences.translation: 精神分裂症最常见的症状之一是幻听。

sentences.sentence: Seth was tormented by feelings of guilt.
sentences.translation: 塞思被负罪感折磨着。

sentences.translation: 这些孩子在家接受教育，连续请过几任家庭教师。

sentences.sentence: The fabrics are sold wholesale to retailers, fashion houses, and other manufacturers.
sentences.translation: 这些纺织品批发给零售商、时装店和其他厂家。

sentences.sentence: It is important that an adolescent boy should have an adult in whom he can confide.
sentences.translation: 一个青春期男孩应该有一个他能倾吐心声的成年人，这是很重要的。

sentences.sentence: I think everyone has something from their past that they're worried might adversely affect how they raise their children.
sentences.translation: 我想每个人都会担心自己过去的某些事可能会对他们如何培养孩子产生不利的影响。

sentences.sentence: As my national security advisor, he had to deal with the British on many other issues that could be adversely affected by the visa.
sentences.translation: 作为我的国家安全顾问，托尼需要在许多其它问题上与英国人打交道，签证问题可能会对这些问题产生不利的影响。

sentences.sentence: Steve couldn’t hide his amusement.
sentences.translation: 史蒂夫忍俊不禁。

sentences.sentence: The cats are a constant source of amusement to us.
sentences.translation: 那些猫给我们带来无穷的乐趣。

sentences.sentence: He’s serving an apprenticeship as a printer.
sentences.translation: 他现在是一名印刷工学徒。

sentences.sentence: a five-year apprenticeship
sentences.translation: 五年学徒期

phrases.translation: 酌情；[拉丁语]视情况而定

sentences.sentence: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
sentences.translation: 通告发布的时机很合适。

sentences.sentence: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
sentences.translation: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

sentences.sentence: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
sentences.translation: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

sentences.sentence: I can assure you that appropriate action will be taken.
sentences.translation: 我向你保证会采取适当的行动。

sentences.sentence: He felt that she had betrayed him.
sentences.translation: 他感觉她背叛了自己。

sentences.sentence: She had betrayed her parents' trust .
sentences.translation: 她辜负了父母对她的信任。

sentences.sentence: I would never betray a confidence (=  tell a secret that someone has trusted me with  ) .
sentences.translation: 我永远不会泄露秘密。

sentences.sentence: The school attracts a high calibre of student.
sentences.translation: 这所学校吸引高素质的学生。

sentences.sentence: He is a carpenter by profession.
sentences.translation: 他以木工为业。

sentences.sentence: At an early age, I was apprenticed to a carpenter.
sentences.translation: 我小时候曾给木匠当过学徒。

sentences.sentence: That carpenter wanted to become a lawyer， but he was advised to stick to his last.
sentences.translation: 那个木匠想当律师， 但别人劝他安分守己地干他自己的老本行。

phrases.translation: 迎合；供应伙食；为…提供所需

sentences.sentence: We cater to an exclusive clientele.
sentences.translation: 我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

sentences.sentence: The judge cited a 1956 Supreme Court ruling in her decision.
sentences.translation: 法官在她的判决中引用了1956年最高法院的一项裁决。

sentences.sentence: A clumsy waiter spilled wine all over her new skirt.
sentences.translation: 一名笨手笨脚的服务员把葡萄酒洒得她新裙子上到处都是。

sentences.sentence: a clumsy attempt to catch the ball
sentences.translation: 笨拙的接球动作

sentences.sentence: Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
sentences.translation: 节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。

sentences.sentence: Ruth hesitated, uncertain of how to combine honesty and diplomacy in her answer.
sentences.translation: 露丝犹豫了，她不知道怎样回答才能既诚实又婉转。

sentences.sentence: On Saturday, they giggled at a Michael Jackson imitator wearing headphones and doing a comically poor imitation of the artist, seemingly for himself.
sentences.translation: 一位迈克杰克逊的模仿者逗得他们咯咯笑，他戴着耳机，滑稽地模仿麦克，好像并不为给别人看。

sentences.sentence: Strangely, and comically, a concrete bunker capable of withstanding a direct hit from anything the Germans could throw at it was built for Churchill's use, and that of his wartime government.
sentences.translation: 不可思议而滑稽的是，一个足以抵挡从柏林投掷过来的任何东西的混凝土地下堡垒是建来给丘吉尔和他的战时政府用的。

sentences.sentence: Eventually one of the bears managed to shove his brother off the end of the log, leaving him clinging on comically.
sentences.translation: 最终，一只熊宝宝成功地把它的兄弟推到了树桩下，而失败的熊宝宝只好滑稽地吊在树桩的边缘上晃来晃去。

text:
英语词汇 · 专四 · 第 9 单元

swell
音标：英 /swel/  美 /swɛl/
v. 肿胀
短语：swell up — 润胀，膨胀
短语：swell with — 膨胀；充满
例句：Her ankle was already starting to swell.
她的脚踝已经开始肿起来了。
例句：The window frame was swollen shut.
窗框膨胀变形，关得死死的。

symptom
音标：英 /ˈsɪmptəm/  美 /'sɪmptəm/
n. 症状
短语：symptom complex — 症候群
例句：One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
精神分裂症最常见的症状之一是幻听。

torment
音标：英 /ˈtɔ:ment/  美 /'tɔrmɛnt/
v. 折磨，使痛苦
例句：Seth was tormented by feelings of guilt.
塞思被负罪感折磨着。

trap
音标：英 /træp/  美 /træp/
v. 使落入圈套
短语：on trap — 可得的；随时可用的
短语：steam trap — 疏水阀；疏水器；汽水分离器；凝汽阀
短语：ion trap — 离子阱
短语：trap door — [建]天窗；陷阱门；[建]地板或屋顶上的活门
短语：set a trap — 设陷阱
短语：gas trap — 气体收集器；气体分离器；气阱
短语：fall into a trap — 落入圈套
短语：sand trap — 分沙器；[美]沙坑障碍
短语：poverty trap — 贫困陷阱
短语：condensate trap — [化]冷凝阱；冷凝槽
短语：stratigraphic trap — 地层圈闭；地层封闭
短语：fault trap — [地质]断层圈闭；断层封闭
短语：cold trap — 冷阱；冷却抽集器
短语：booby trap — 恶作剧；[军]诡雷；诱杀装置
短语：steel trap — 捕兽夹
短语：death trap — 危险建筑；危险场所
例句：The police trapped the terrorists at a roadblock.
警察在设有路障的地方堵住了恐怖分子。

tutor
音标：英 /‘tju:tə(r)/  美 /'tʊtɚ/
n. 导师
短语：private tutor — 私人教师，家庭教师
短语：tutor system — 导师制
例句：The children were educated at home by a succession of tutors.
这些孩子在家接受教育，连续请过几任家庭教师。

wholesale
音标：英 /ˈhəʊlseɪl/  美 /'holsel/
adv. 批发销售
短语：wholesale market — 批发市场
短语：wholesale price — 批发价格
短语：wholesale business — 批发业务，批发生意
短语：wholesale trade — 批发贸易
短语：wholesale goods — 批发货
短语：wholesale banking — 对同业及大客户的大金额银行业务
短语：wholesale cost — 批发成本
短语：wholesale distributor — 批发商
例句：The fabrics are sold wholesale to retailers, fashion houses, and other manufacturers.
这些纺织品批发给零售商、时装店和其他厂家。

adolescent
音标：英 /ˌædəˈlesnt/  美 /,ædə'lɛsnt/
adj. 青春期的；青少年
短语：adolescent health — 青少年健康
例句：It is important that an adolescent boy should have an adult in whom he can confide.
一个青春期男孩应该有一个他能倾吐心声的成年人，这是很重要的。

adversely
音标：英 /əd'vɜ:slɪ/  美 /æd'vɝsli/
adv. 不利地
例句：I think everyone has something from their past that they're worried might adversely affect how they raise their children.
我想每个人都会担心自己过去的某些事可能会对他们如何培养孩子产生不利的影响。
例句：As my national security advisor, he had to deal with the British on many other issues that could be adversely affected by the visa.
作为我的国家安全顾问，托尼需要在许多其它问题上与英国人打交道，签证问题可能会对这些问题产生不利的影响。

amusement
音标：英 /əˈmju:zmənt/  美 /ə'mjuzmənt/
n. 娱乐
短语：amusement park — 游乐园
短语：amusement center — 娱乐中心
例句：Steve couldn’t hide his amusement.
史蒂夫忍俊不禁。
例句：The cats are a constant source of amusement to us.
那些猫给我们带来无穷的乐趣。

apprenticeship
音标：英 /əˈprentɪʃɪp/  美 /ə'prɛntɪʃɪp/
n. 学徒期；学徒身份
例句：He’s serving an apprenticeship as a printer.
他现在是一名印刷工学徒。
例句：a five-year apprenticeship
五年学徒期

appropriate
音标：英 /əˈprəʊpriət/  美 /əˈpropriɪt/
adj. 恰当的
短语：as appropriate — 酌情；[拉丁语]视情况而定
短语：appropriate time — 适当时间
短语：if appropriate — 任选地；如果有的话
短语：appropriate technology — 适当的技术；适用技术
短语：be appropriate for — 适合于
短语：appropriate authority — 有关当局
例句：The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
通告发布的时机很合适。
例句：Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。
例句：Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。
例句：I can assure you that appropriate action will be taken.
我向你保证会采取适当的行动。

betray
音标：英 /bɪˈtreɪ/  美 /bɪ'tre/
v. 背叛
短语：betray oneself — 原形毕露
例句：He felt that she had betrayed him.
他感觉她背叛了自己。
例句：She had betrayed her parents' trust .
她辜负了父母对她的信任。
例句：I would never betray a confidence (=  tell a secret that someone has trusted me with  ) .
我永远不会泄露秘密。

calibre
音标：英 /ˈkælɪbə(r)/  美 /'kælibə/
n. 能力; 水准
例句：The school attracts a high calibre of student.
这所学校吸引高素质的学生。

carpenter
音标：英 /ˈkɑ:pəntə(r)/  美 /ˈkɑːrpəntər/
n. 木工，木匠
例句：He is a carpenter by profession.
他以木工为业。
例句：At an early age, I was apprenticed to a carpenter.
我小时候曾给木匠当过学徒。
例句：That carpenter wanted to become a lawyer， but he was advised to stick to his last.
那个木匠想当律师， 但别人劝他安分守己地干他自己的老本行。

cater
音标：英 /ˈkeɪtə(r)/  美 /'ketɚ/
v. 迎合；满足需要
短语：cater for — 迎合；供应伙食；为…提供所需
例句：We cater to an exclusive clientele.
我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

cite
音标：英 /saɪt/  美 /saɪt/
v. 引用，引证
短语：cite an example — 举例；引用一个例子
例句：The judge cited a 1956 Supreme Court ruling in her decision.
法官在她的判决中引用了1956年最高法院的一项裁决。

clumsy
音标：英 /ˈklʌmzi/  美 /'klʌmzi/
adj. 笨拙的
例句：A clumsy waiter spilled wine all over her new skirt.
一名笨手笨脚的服务员把葡萄酒洒得她新裙子上到处都是。
例句：a clumsy attempt to catch the ball
笨拙的接球动作

combine
音标：英 /kəmˈbaɪn/  美 /kəm'baɪn/
v. 将...相结合
短语：combine with — vt. 与...结合
短语：combine harvester — 联合收割机
例句：Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。
例句：Ruth hesitated, uncertain of how to combine honesty and diplomacy in her answer.
露丝犹豫了，她不知道怎样回答才能既诚实又婉转。

comically
音标：英 /'kɒmɪklɪ/
adv. 滑稽地
例句：On Saturday, they giggled at a Michael Jackson imitator wearing headphones and doing a comically poor imitation of the artist, seemingly for himself.
一位迈克杰克逊的模仿者逗得他们咯咯笑，他戴着耳机，滑稽地模仿麦克，好像并不为给别人看。
例句：Strangely, and comically, a concrete bunker capable of withstanding a direct hit from anything the Germans could throw at it was built for Churchill's use, and that of his wartime government.
不可思议而滑稽的是，一个足以抵挡从柏林投掷过来的任何东西的混凝土地下堡垒是建来给丘吉尔和他的战时政府用的。
例句：Eventually one of the bears managed to shove his brother off the end of the log, leaving him clinging on comically.
最终，一只熊宝宝成功地把它的兄弟推到了树桩下，而失败的熊宝宝只好滑稽地吊在树桩的边缘上晃来晃去。

criterion
音标：英 /kraɪˈtɪəriən/  美 /kraɪˈtɪriən/
n. 标准
短语：evaluation criterion — 评估标准
短语：design criterion — 设计标准；设计准则；设计规范
短语：failure criterion — 失效准则；故障判据；抗剪强度破坏准则
短语：stability criterion — 稳定性判据
短语：fracture criterion — 断裂判据，断裂准则；断裂指标
短语：technical criterion — 技术标准
短语：similarity criterion — 相似准则
短语：performance criterion — 性能判据；性能标准
短语：criterion function — 准则函数；判别函数
短语：error criterion — 误差准则，误差判据
短语：convergence criterion — 收敛性判定准则；收敛性判据
短语：optimality criterion — 最优性判别；最优性准则
短语：criterion validity — 效标效度
例句：the criteria we use to select candidates
我们挑选候选人的标准
